chapter: Touring, band and money in the 1950s-60s
title: Pay in the 1950s, five dollars for four hours
summary: Gigs paid five or six dollars a piece; the whole band split five dollars after four hours.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: How much did y'all get for a gig back then?
In the 50s? What was good money?
In the 50s. Five or six dollars a piece was considered a good one.

You couldn't do anything like that, huh? Even for you? Sure. Everybody. Everybody got the same thing. Five or six dollars a piece. Even when you had the records out and everything? Things like the price should have gone up.
Played for four hours and only come out with six dollars. Yeah. We played. I've seen it in time we played for four hours and came out with five dollars among us.
This is what I got for the recording for cutting that first record. I don't know what I'll do. Five dollars. Five dollars.
